mapper.sql: select t.id, t.name, t.sort, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, t.country_id, t.code, co.name as country_name from voya_ai_province t left join voya_ai_country co on co.id = t.country_id
mapper.select: select * from voya_ai_province where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
select count(*) from voya_ai_province where name = #{name} and country_id = #{countryId} and id != #{id}
select count(*) from voya_ai_city where province_id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_province (name, sort, status, remark, country_id, code, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values (#{name}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{countryId}, #{code}, #{createBy}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), '0')
mapper.update: update voya_ai_province set name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, country_id = #{countryId}, code = #{code}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_province set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update voya_ai_province set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{username}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where t.del_flag = '0' and t.country_id = #{countryId} and co.del_flag = '0' and t.status = '0' and co.status = '0' order by t.sort desc, t.id desc
